task.description: Design integration tests for Stage 10. Every MUST requirement (REPO-01 through REPO-13) MUST have a runnable integration test. No deferred work. Tests must verify: content addressing deduplication, immutability enforcement, version history with parent linkage, canonical serialisation consistency, form schema indexing queryability, event type registry validation, service catalog enforcement, atomic activation of bundles, per-tenant activation isolation, activation history audit trail, create-artifact API roundtrip, version list pagination, and tenant activation consistency. All tests use real PostgreSQL via BPM_TEST_DB_URL.
acceptance_criteria: Every MUST requirement has integration test
Tests fail clearly if BPM_TEST_DB_URL absent
Test files created under tests/ or web/src/ per convention

result.summary: Completed test design for Stage 10 (REPO-01-13): created comprehensive test specification with 26 test cases and corresponding Zig integration tests for all 13 MUST requirements. All tests use real PostgreSQL via BPM_TEST_DB_URL, employ per-test UUIDs for isolation, and clean up via transaction rollback. No deferred work; all MUST requirements have executable tests.
